The Sitecore XM Cloud REST API provides endpoints for creating and managing collections, sites, pages, languages, and publishing jobs within an XM Cloud tenant. It covers the full lifecycle of site and collection management through the XM Apps system, exposes page authoring operations, and enables programmatic control of publishing workflows. The API follows RESTful conventions and is authenticated via OAuth 2.0 tokens obtained from the Sitecore Cloud Portal automation client credentials. It is organized into several functional areas: the Sites API for managing sites, site collections, and languages; the Pages API for managing site pages; and the Publishing API for creating, monitoring, and managing publishing jobs.
